hints.title: Doubling Array Contents
hints.text: Allocate an array of size 2n and duplicate the elements across both halves.

hints.title: Index Mapping Relationship
hints.text: For index i from 0 to n - 1, assign ans[i] = nums[i] and ans[i + n] = nums[i].

hints.title: Direct List Duplication
hints.text: Most modern languages provide native concatenation operators to double the array directly.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of elements in nums
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeated append operations can trigger multiple array reallocations without pre-sizing.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Pre-allocating array of size 2N achieves optimal O(N) allocation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should provide concise and clean solution.
